title: oxybaphus nyctagineus var. pilosus
intro: Oxybaphus nyctagineus var. pilosus, commonly known as the hairy four o'clock, is a variety of flowering plant in the four o'clock family (Nyctaginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The hairy four o'clock is also reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-anxiety, and anti-depressive effects. The bioactive constituents of Oxybaphus nyctagineus var. pilosus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
